scope: First-mark identities for one original leaf in any finite ordinary tree, plus the full eligible lower-region aggregate for stars K_{1,m}.

definitions.G_w: H minus (W_<w union N_H[w]) for a fixed total order on W

star_certificate.first_descent: x=ceil(m/2); Delta_0=m>0, Delta_1=binom(m,2)-(m+1)>0, and for j>=2 through m, Delta_j=binom(m,j+1)-binom(m,j); Delta_m=-1; later zero-extended differences are 0
star_certificate.window_nonempty: p>=8; empty for p<=7 (p=6 would require 9<=m<=8, p=7 would require 11<=m<=10)
star_certificate.selector: Every original leaf qualifies because Delta_p(K_{1,m-1})=binom(m-1,p+1)-binom(m-1,p)<0 in the exact window

verification: Direct binomial-ratio inequalities and the unique-first-mark bijection; no computation or imported theorem is used.
limitations: The marked-shell identities do not establish the sign of the selected aggregate for general trees.
The star certificate does not cover p=6 or p=7 and resolves no general-tree exception at those ranks.
No universal conclusion follows from this family result.
